description: This Java source file defines the ImportService class responsible for importing books from Goodreads format into the application's data model. It handles mapping Goodreads import data to Book entities, resolving shelves, authors, and ratings, and saving valid books via the BookService.

classes.name: ImportService
classes.description: Service class used to import and process books data from Goodreads format, converting them into the internal data model and persisting them.

methods.name: importGoodreadsBooks
methods.description: Imports books from Goodreads format and saves valid Book entities, returning the list of saved books.

methods.name: toBooks
methods.description: Converts a collection of GoodreadsBookImport objects into a list of Book objects.

methods.name: toBook
methods.description: Transforms a single GoodreadsBookImport into a Book, resolving author, shelves, and ratings.

methods.name: toAuthor
methods.description: Creates an Author object from a name string, if valid.

methods.name: toPredefinedShelf
methods.description: Resolves a predefined shelf based on shelves string and date read status.

methods.name: toCustomShelf
methods.description: Creates or finds a custom shelf based on shelves string excluding predefined shelves.

methods.name: toRatingScale
methods.description: Converts a rating value into a RatingScale object, applying a scale factor.
